answer: Because the timing is entered against the sable challenge, the oasis audit can replay the yarrow history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 179 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
